process() returns error when config language is unknown

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go/v2"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `nonexistent_xyz`,
	}
	_, err := tspack.Process(`x = 1`, config)
	var typedError *tspack.Error
	if errors.As(err, &typedError) {
		fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%T: %v\n", typedError, typedError)
	}
}
```
